title: 第2章 失踪
content_zh:
第2章失踪
“兵哥寄来的？”
张元清看完信上的内容，皱起眉头。
什么叫改变人生？什么叫无法驾驭？
真是的，话也不说清楚他再次把目光投向黑色卡片，反复观察，确认这只是一张平平无奇的卡，非要说不同寻常，就是手感不错，材质似乎很稀有。
难道是某个顶级会所的至尊卡？36D的小姐姐确实只有我这样的奇男子能驾驭。
雷一兵是他从小玩到大的死党，小名阿兵，比他大两岁，外公外婆还没有购置新房时，两家住在一个胡同里。
雷一兵力速双a，智力c，从小就很罩他，打架冲在前头，挨打留下断后，谁要是嘲笑张元清是没爹的孩子，雷一兵就会替他出头。
所以张元清一直喊他兵哥。
阿兵高中时成绩并不理想，因此去隔壁的江南省念了大学，打那以后，分隔两地的他们联系就少了。
张元清一边把黑卡放进冲锋衣口袋，一边拿起手机给兵哥发送信息调侃：
“是哪家会所的至尊卡，至少给我地址或者联系方式吧。”
这条信息发过去，半小时了都没收到回复。
张元清索性拨通兵哥的电话。
“嘟嘟”两声后，电话接通，扬声器里传来男人低沉的声音：
“喂！我是雷一兵父亲。”
“雷叔叔？”张元清一怔，旋即欣喜道：
“兵哥这周回松海了？你让他接一下电话，我有事找他。”
电话那边沉默一下，继而响起沉痛的嗓音：
“元子，我在江南省。阿兵他失踪了.”

兵哥失踪了？！张元清呆立当场，隔了几秒，又茫然又急切的问道：
“怎么回事？”
兵哥怎么会失踪，他明明还给我寄了东西。
“大前天失踪的，我和你周姨昨天收到学校的通知，就立刻赶过去了。”雷叔叔情绪低落。
“报警了吗，治安署的人怎么说？”张元清沉声道。
雷叔叔沉默了很久，有些犹豫的说道：
“这件事挺不好说的，阿兵丢的有些奇怪.”
奇怪？什么意思.张元清一愣。
雷叔叔说道：
“阿兵是大前天夜里在寝室失踪的，警察调取了宿舍楼道里的监控，发现阿兵一整晚都没出寝室，可第二天一早，人就不见了。
“同寝室的学生说，睡觉前还看到他的，醒来就没人了，还以为他只是出去了。”
张元清脱口而出：“这怎么可能”
难道人会凭空消失吗，这种说辞三岁孩子都不会信。
张元清压下心里的焦虑，压低声音道：
“雷叔，兵哥是不是在学校得罪什么人了？”
他首先想到的是，兵哥在学校得罪了人，对方在当地拥有一定的权力，所以监控才会看不出问题，因为这往往意味着校方存在包庇行为。
信息大爆炸的时代，但凡上过网的人多多少少都听说过类似的事。
“校领导说会尽量配合警方，警察们则说让我们回去等消息，他们会调查的.我和你阿姨一整晚都没睡。”
雷叔叔语气里夹杂着沮丧和担忧。
果然是这种回答，该死张元清深吸一口气，安抚道：

“您先别急，我外公和表哥都是治安署上班的，这您是知道的。回头我问问他们该怎么处理这种事，要注意哪些东西，您有什么不懂的，要咨询的，也尽管打电话联系我。
“另外，您一定要问问学校的同学，如果兵哥得罪了什么人，肯定会有同学知道。”
雷叔叔心里稍宽，道：
“知道了，元子，你也别担心，有消息我会第一时间告诉你。”
挂断电话，张元清有些坐立难安，在房间里来回踱步，担忧着兵哥的安危。
人不可能无缘无故失踪，监控拍不到，那肯定是监控被动了手脚，就是不知道兵哥得罪了什么人。
但一个大三的学生，又能得罪谁呢？
等等，大前天失踪的
大前天？！
张元清猛的一惊，快递包裹从江南省到松海，需要2—3天的时间，按照时间推算，兵哥是给我寄完东西的当晚失踪
这是巧合？还是说其中有什么关联。
想到这里，他本能的去摸口袋里的黑卡，可当他把手伸进口袋时，突然愣住了。
黑色卡片不见了。
掉地上了？张元清连忙低头，目光在房间地板快速扫过。
他趴到地上往床底看，床底铺着一层灰，以及一些硬币、笔、纽扣等杂物，但没有黑卡。
那张卡片不见了，而他记得很清楚，东西被他放进口袋里了。
怎么就凭空消失了？
联想到兵哥的神秘失踪、内容奇怪的信件，以及诡异消失的黑色卡片，张元清心里莫名的惊恐和茫然。
“黑卡会不会和兵哥失踪有关？或者是重要线索？”
深吸一口气，张元清决定用自己的“旧疾”重启一下记忆。

他先往玻璃杯里倒了凉水，从床头柜拿出药瓶，拧开，然后脱掉鞋子躺在床上。
做完这一切，他闭上眼睛，一动不动，于脑海里观想父亲的脸。
旧疾主动触发的条件是静下心来想象一个画面，最好是曾经见过，但又记不太清楚的。
这样会激发大脑活力，慢慢预热，最后脑力沸腾。
时隔多年，父亲的脸早已模糊不清，正是最完美的对象。
时间一分一秒过去，父亲的脸渐渐从模糊到清晰，最后纤毫毕现，而张元清的心脏剧烈跳动过，宛如超负荷的引擎。
这一刻，时间仿佛倒流，一小时前的画面，如同影视剧般，一帧帧的闪过。
他看到自己拆开快递包裹，看完信件，把黑色卡片放进了冲锋衣口袋，接下来是给兵哥发信息。
到这里，接下来的半小时，他坐在桌边一动不动，刷了十几分钟的短视频，在游戏群里和lsp们互发了几张涩图。
保存了几张优质的图片。
然后看了几分钟的小说，因为总想着卡片的事，就给兵哥打了电话。
打完电话后，关键时刻到了，他急的在房间里到处乱走，这里是最容易掉卡片的时间点。
记忆画面里，他看见自己皱着眉头在房间里踱步，然后伸手去摸黑色卡片，发现卡片没了。
张元清霍然睁眼，满脸惊恐。
没了？！
黑卡就这样没了，凭空消失。
兵哥特么的到底给我寄了什么东西.一瞬间，他有些头皮发麻。
来不及多想，耳边响起混乱的噪音，像是无数人的声音叠加在一起，脑海里破碎的画面犹如喷发的火山，一股脑儿的涌上。
张元清鼻子有温热的液体流过，脑袋仿佛被打入钢钉。
他脸色扭曲的爬向床头，哆哆嗦嗦的倒出五粒蓝色小药丸塞进嘴里，再哆哆嗦嗦的拿起水杯，仰头把药丸和水一起吞进肚子。

片刻后，张元清脸色发白的坐在床头喘息。
到这里，他基本可以确定，兵哥的失踪和黑卡存在一定的联系。
“兵哥是在给我寄出黑卡后失踪的，而那张黑卡存在诡异，显然不是普通东西.”
这不得不让人联想到，他可能遭受了什么威胁，迫不得己转移物品。
“可他为什么不交给当地治安署，反而寄给了我。”
难道我一个鸡都没杀过，也没睡过的大学生，比警署的警员还靠谱？
张元清陡然间想到“监控和寝室人员没有察觉出异常”这个细节。
而能做到这个程度的，必然得拥有一定的权势。
兵哥没有把黑卡上交当地治安署，是因为治安署也不可信？
或者说，那个导致他消失的人或势力，影响力覆盖到了当地治安署。
“他把黑卡寄给我，是因为知道外公是退休警长，表哥是治安队长，在松海市有着相当深厚的人脉，江南省那边的人，无法影响到我？”
得把这事告诉表哥。
“叮咚～”
这时，他听见了门铃声，从玄关传来的门铃声。
外婆的脚步声旋即响起，穿过客厅来到玄关，拧开了门把手。
“你们找谁？”
“你好，我们是康阳区治安署调查员，请问张元清在家吗。”
门外的人回应道。

content_en:
Chapter 2 Missing
"Sent from Brother Bing?"
Zhang Yuanqing frowned after reading the contents of the letter.
What does it mean to change your life? What does it mean to be unable to control?
Really, he couldn't explain clearly. He once again turned his attention to the black card, and after repeated observations, he confirmed that it was just an ordinary card. It must be said that it was unusual, but it felt good and the material seemed to be very rare.
Could it be a supreme card from a top club? A 36D girl can only be controlled by a strange man like me.
Lei Yibing has been his best friend since childhood. His nickname is A Bing. He is two years older than him. Before his grandparents bought a new house, the two families lived in the same alley.
Lei Yibing has double A in strength and speed and C in intelligence. He has been a fan of him since he was a child. He rushes to the front in fights and leaves behind when he is beaten. If anyone ridicules Zhang Yuanqing for being a child without a father, Lei Yibing will stand up for him.
So Zhang Yuanqing kept calling him Brother Bing.
A Bing's grades in high school were not satisfactory, so he went to college in the neighboring Jiangnan Province. After that, they kept in touch with each other even though they were separated.
Zhang Yuanqing put the black card into the pocket of his jacket and picked up his mobile phone to send a message to Brother Bing:
"Which club does it have the Supreme Card from? At least give me the address or contact information."
I sent this message and haven’t received a reply for half an hour.
Zhang Yuanqing simply dialed Brother Bing's phone number.
After two beeps, the phone was connected, and a man's deep voice came from the speaker:
"Hello! I am Lei Yibing's father."
"Uncle Lei?" Zhang Yuanqing was startled, then said happily:
"Brother Bing returned to Songhai this week? Ask him to answer the phone. I'll see him if I have anything to do."
There was silence on the other side of the phone, and then a deep voice sounded:
"Yuanzi, I'm in Jiangnan Province. Ah Bing is missing."
Brother Bing is missing? ! Zhang Yuanqing stood blankly on the spot. After a few seconds, he asked confusedly and eagerly:
"What's going on?"
How come Brother Bing disappeared? He clearly sent me something.
"She disappeared the day before yesterday. Your Aunt Zhou and I received the notice from the school yesterday and rushed there immediately." Uncle Lei was in a low mood.
"Have you called the police? What did the people from the Public Security Department say?" Zhang Yuanqing said solemnly.
Uncle Lei was silent for a long time and said hesitantly:
"It's hard to talk about this matter. It's a bit strange how the soldier was lost."
Strange? What do you mean? Zhang Yuanqing was stunned.
Uncle Lei said:
"A Bing disappeared from his dormitory the night before yesterday. The police called the surveillance camera in the dormitory corridor and found that A Bing had not left the dormitory all night, but he disappeared early the next morning.
“Students in the same dormitory said they saw him before going to bed, but when they woke up there was no one there, and they thought he had just gone out. "
Zhang Yuanqing blurted out: "How is this possible?"
Can people disappear out of thin air? Even a three-year-old child would not believe this.
Zhang Yuanqing suppressed the anxiety in his heart and lowered his voice:
"Uncle Lei, did Brother Bing offend someone at school? "
The first thing he thought of was that Brother Bing had offended someone at school, and that person had a certain amount of power in the local area, so the surveillance would not detect the problem, because this often meant that the school was shielding him.
In the era of information explosion, anyone who has ever surfed the Internet has heard of similar things.
"The school leaders said they would try their best to cooperate with the police, but the police told us to go back and wait for news, and they would investigate. Your aunt and I didn't sleep all night. "
Uncle Ray's tone was mixed with frustration and worry.
As expected, this was the answer. Damn it, Zhang Yuanqing took a deep breath and said comfortingly:
"Don't worry, my grandpa and cousin both work for the Sheriff's Department, you know this. I will ask them later how to deal with this kind of thing and what they should pay attention to. If you don’t understand anything and want to consult, please feel free to call me.
"In addition, you must ask your classmates at school. If Brother Bing offends anyone, some classmates will definitely know."
Uncle Lei felt a little more relaxed and said:"I understand, Motoko, don't worry, I will tell you the news as soon as possible."
After hanging up the phone, Zhang Yuanqing felt uneasy and paced back and forth in the room, worried about Brother Bing's safety.
It's impossible for people to disappear for no reason, and if the surveillance camera can't capture it, then the surveillance camera must be tampered with, and they just don't know who Brother Bing has offended.
But who can a junior student offend?
Wait, he disappeared the day before yesterday.
The day before yesterday? !
Zhang Yuanqing was shocked. It takes 2-3 days to express a package from Jiangnan Province to Songhai. According to the time, Brother Bing disappeared the night after he sent me the things.
Is this a coincidence? Or is there any connection between them.
Thinking of this, he instinctively touched the black card in his pocket, but when he put his hand into his pocket, he suddenly froze.
The black card is missing.
Did it fall to the ground? Zhang Yuanqing quickly lowered his head and glanced quickly across the floor of the room.
He lay on the ground and looked under the bed. There was a layer of dust under the bed, as well as some coins, pens, buttons and other miscellaneous items, but there was no black card.
The card was gone, but he remembered clearly that he had put the item in his pocket.
Why did it disappear out of thin air?
Thinking of Brother Bing's mysterious disappearance, letters with strange contents, and black cards that mysteriously disappeared, Zhang Yuanqing felt inexplicably frightened and confused.
"Is the black card related to Brother Bing's disappearance? Or is it an important clue?"
Taking a deep breath, Zhang Yuanqing decided to use his "old illness" to restart his memory.
He first poured cold water into the glass, took out the medicine bottle from the bedside table, unscrewed it, then took off his shoes and lay on the bed.
After doing all this, he closed his eyes, remained motionless, and visualized his father's face in his mind.
The condition for the active triggering of old illness is to calm down and imagine a picture, preferably something you have seen before but can't remember clearly.
This will stimulate the vitality of the brain, slowly warm it up, and finally the brain power will boil.
After many years, my father's face has long been blurred, and he is the perfect object.
As time passed, his father's face gradually changed from blurry to clear, and finally appeared in detail, while Zhang Yuanqing's heart beat violently, like an overloaded engine.
At this moment, time seemed to flow backwards, and the scenes from an hour ago flashed by frame by frame like a movie or TV drama.
He saw himself opening the express package, reading the letter, putting the black card into the pocket of his jacket, and then sending a message to Brother Bing.
From here, for the next half hour, he sat motionless at the table, watched short videos for more than ten minutes, and exchanged a few dirty pictures with LSPs in the game group.
Saved several good quality pictures.
Then I read a novel for a few minutes, and because I kept thinking about the card, I called Brother Bing.
After making the call, the critical moment came. He anxiously walked around the room. This was the most likely time to drop the card.
In the memory screen, he saw himself pacing the room with a frown on his face, then reached out to touch the black card and found that the card was gone.
Zhang Yuanqing suddenly opened his eyes, his face full of horror.
Gone? !
The black card just disappeared and disappeared into thin air.
What the hell did Bing Ge send me? For a moment, his scalp went numb.
Before he had time to think about it, a chaotic noise sounded in his ears, like the voices of countless people superimposed together, and the broken images in his mind surged up like an erupting volcano.
Warm liquid flowed through Zhang Yuanqing's nose, and it felt as if a steel nail had been driven into his head.
He crawled to the bedside with a twisted face, tremblingly poured five small blue pills into his mouth, then tremblingly picked up the water glass, raised his head and swallowed the pills and water into his stomach.
After a while, Zhang Yuanqing sat on the bedside with a pale face and panted.
At this point, he was basically certain that there was a certain connection between Brother Bing's disappearance and the black card.
"Brother Bing disappeared after sending me a black card, and there was something strange about that black card. It was obviously not an ordinary thing."
This is not allowedIt doesn't make people think that he may have been threatened by some kind of threat and had to move the items.
"But why didn't he give it to the local Sheriff's Department instead of sending it to me?"
Am I, a college student who has never killed a chicken or slept with me, more reliable than a police officer in the police station?
Zhang Yuanqing suddenly thought of the detail that "the surveillance and dormitory personnel did not detect any abnormalities."
And those who can achieve this level must have a certain amount of power.
Brother Bing didn't hand over the black card to the local Sheriff's Department. Was it because the Sheriff's Department couldn't be trusted?
In other words, the person or force that caused him to disappear had influence that extended to the local Public Security Department.
"He sent me the black card because he knew that my grandfather is a retired police chief, my cousin is a security captain, and he has very deep connections in Songhai City. People over there in Jiangnan Province can't influence me?"
I have to tell my cousin about this.
"Ding dong~"
At this time, he heard the doorbell ringing from the entrance hall.
Grandma's footsteps sounded immediately, she walked through the living room to the entrance and turned the door handle.
"Who are you looking for?"
"Hello, we are investigators from the Kangyang District Public Security Department. Is Zhang Yuanqing at home?"
The person outside the door responded.
